messages:
marta: Heads-up: Dedicated product planning thread — we need to finalize autoscale and burst policy tradeoffs for Q3 roadmap. Main asks: SLA language, customer isolation levels, burst > reserved behavior. Decision by Fri EOD pls.

devin: Can we list concrete failure modes we need to cover? e.g., no-capacity, noisy-tenant, slow-start after scale-up.

xiang: From runtime testing: scale-up latency to reach 95% throughput still ~45s on p4d; cold-start for new model container ~90s. Continuous batching helps but first-request latency spikes.

samir: Customer X (fintech) asked for guaranteed tail latency 99.9 at 100 qps — they want isolation at host-level; can't afford noisy neighbors. They've threatened to keep running on prem otherwise.

elaine: Proposed options: A) Host isolation + reserved capacity (higher $) B) Soft isolation via priority routing & burst tokens C) Hybrid: reserved for critical customers + shared for others. Need cost delta for each.

ops-bot: recent capacity snapshot: reserved_pools utilization 72%, shared_pools 87%, burst_events last 7d: 142. Latency tail spikes correlated with shared pool >80%.

xiang: Implementation notes: priority routing + token bucket burst is cheapest to build. Pseudocode config:

```
autoscale:
  mode: priority
  burst_token_rate: 10rps
  burst_bucket: 50
  fallback: degrade_to_smaller_model
```

But we must wire metrics to console for per-customer visibility.

devin: For SLAs we need objective + SLO + credits. Suggest: objective = 99.5% p95, SLO = 99.0% p99 for shared; reserved customers get 99.9% p99 with credit floor.

marta: Agree. Also need explicit launch criteria: perf test with 3 models, failover tested, docs + console UI for burst settings, customer migration doc.

samir: I'll draft migration playbook and capture Customer X's acceptance criteria. Need decision on hybrid by Thu so we can get eng estimate.

elaine: Prioritization asks: if we choose Hybrid, it pushes dev by 2 sprints. If Soft isolation only, less eng work but higher churn from enterprise sales.

xiang: Estimate: Soft isolation ~3 engineer-sprints. Hybrid ~8 sprints + infra changes. Host isolation (~dedicated hosts per customer) is mostly sales/legal + infra ops, ~10 sprints + capacity.

marta: :white_check_mark: Action items: Samir draft acceptance + get Customer X ok; Xiang produce perf matrix + cost delta; Devin write proposed SLA language; Elaine update roadmap doc with tradeoffs. Check-in Thu 10am.

devin: Small note: consider autoscale cooldown tuning to reduce flapping — default 30s is too small.

samir: Customer X replied earlier: 'Hybrid looks acceptable if preemption guarantees exist'. I'll push for that nuance.

elaine: OK — I'll schedule canary for Hybrid on a few reserved pools once eng signals ready. Thanks all.
